issues.title: Create snapshot package with Load function (TDD)
issues.dod: TDD: write 4 failing tests (empty dir, single issue, worker-ID mismatch warning, state+issues agreement), then implement snapshot.Load(opsDir, stateDir, singleBranch) so all 4 pass. make check green.
acceptance: snapshot package imports only ops and materialize (no cmd or tui)
notes: Snapshot struct: State *materialize.State, Index materialize.Index, Issues map[string]*materialize.Issue, Warnings []string
Load calls ops.LoadFromDirWithOffsetsValidated, materialize.MaterializeAndReturn, materialize.LoadIndex, materialize.LoadAllIssues
Returns non-nil Snapshot on nil error even for empty opsDir

issues.title: Migrate ready, show, and validate commands to snapshot.Load
issues.dod: Replace the 3-step ops-read + Materialize + LoadIndex/LoadIssue pattern in ready.go, show.go, and validate.go with a single snapshot.Load call. Warnings emitted to stderr. Unused materialize imports removed. go build ./cmd/armature/... and make test pass.
acceptance: each command uses snap.Index / snap.Issues / snap.State (no direct materialize.LoadIssue calls remaining)
notes: validate.go uses snap.State in place of the state returned by MaterializeAndReturn
show.go: replace remaining materialize.LoadIssue calls with snap.Issues[id] lookups
Add os import if missing for stderr warning emission

issues.title: Migrate render-context normal path and TUI doRefresh to snapshot.Load
issues.dod: render_context.go else-branch uses snapshot.Load; loadStateFromStateDir helper removed. TUI model.go doRefresh uses snapshot.Load; local readAllOpsFromDirWithOffsets helper removed. go build ./... and make test pass.
acceptance: readAllOpsFromDirWithOffsets no longer exists in model.go
loadStateFromStateDir no longer exists in render_context.go
notes: render_context.go --at (time-travel) path retains MaterializeAtSHA call unchanged
TUI doRefresh: if err != nil || snap.State == nil return nil
